text: What if your nose grew one inch every day? Day seven. Seven inches. Sunglasses are over for you. Day thirty. Two and a half feet. Every sneeze is now a weather event. Year one. Thirty feet. The airline makes you buy four extra seats. For the nose. Year ten. Three hundred feet. As long as a football field. Birds live on it now. Year fifty. Fifteen hundred feet. Longer than the Empire State Building is tall. Doctors finally find the cause. Day one was the day you told her you loved her cooking. Would you tell her the truth? Comment below.
